title: Code input field
description: Code written in a form: a text, sent as one, written in an editor that colours its language. The language is the field's own (`language`), or chosen by another field of the form (`languageField`, that field's name) whose value is the language — read through `languageMap` where the two do not share a name.

versionsUrl.description: Where the earlier versions of the field's content are read, the record's id where the form's action has it (`__id__`): answering `[{ label, content, date, author }]`, the latest first, without the current one.

language.description: A grammar name: json, yaml, python, markdown, html, css, js, ts, php, twig, jinja. Anything else is plain text.

languageField.description: The name of the field of the form whose value is the language.

languageMap.description: The language of each value of that field, where the two differ: `{ "text": "jinja" }`.
